svg.aria-label: TI TMDS62LEVM Rev. B schematic sheet 29
svg.title: TI TMDS62LEVM Rev. B schematic sheet 29

text.tspan: Shorting of multiple bootmode inputs together is not
recommended or allowed, since the bootmode inputs
have alternate functions that could be
configured after boot (can be set as outputs) Shorting
the bootmode pins directly to VCC or ground directly is
not recommended. Connect each of the bootmode pins
through separate resistor. Choose the bootmode resistor
value based on the use case (10K or similar)
